name: Centum Distributor Pricing Module
description: Fetches live distributor pricing (Mouser, Arrow, Avnet) and detects alternate parts for a BOM

tools.name: centum_distributor_pricing__enrich_bom
tools.description: Fetch live pricing for all parts in the BOM from configured distributors

tools.name: centum_distributor_pricing__export_enriched_bom
tools.description: Export the enriched BOM with distributor pricing to Excel

tools.name: centum_distributor_pricing__export_quote_summary
tools.description: Export a quote summary with best-price selection per part

tools.name: centum_distributor_pricing__detect_alternates
tools.description: Detect alternate/substitute parts for components in the BOM

tools.name: centum_distributor_pricing__apply_alternatives
tools.description: Apply approved alternate parts to the BOM
